cards.d: Anthropology is the study of people, society, and culture.
cards.e: In anthropology class, I learned about simple tools that ancient cultures used.
cards.ielts: Anthropology helps us understand how globalisation is changing traditional customs in small communities.

cards.d: To applaud means to clap in order to show approval.
cards.e: Everyone cheered and applauded Manny’s efforts.
cards.ielts: Many citizens applauded the government's decision to ban single-use plastic bags in supermarkets.

cards.d: To appoint someone to a job means to give the job to them.
cards.e: Two students were appointed to help the scientists with their research.
cards.ielts: Companies should appoint more women to senior positions in order to benefit from a wider range of perspectives.

cards.d: When things are compatible, they work well or exist together successfully.
cards.e: Jan and Fred are too different. They will never be compatible.
cards.ielts: Many experts believe economic growth is fully compatible with protecting the environment, provided that governments invest in clean technology.

cards.d: Competence is the ability to do something well or effectively.
cards.e: The job was easy because the group had enough competence to do it well.
cards.ielts: Online tests are increasingly used to measure the language competence of job applicants.

cards.d: To confer with someone means to discuss something with them to make a decision.
cards.e: I will have to confer with my wife before I can purchase a new car.
cards.ielts: Before deciding on a career, students should confer with teachers and parents who know their strengths.

cards.d: When things are consecutive, they happen one after another without interruption.
cards.e: The king ruled for ten consecutive years.
cards.ielts: Car sales in the country fell for three consecutive years before recovering slightly in 2019.

cards.d: When something is crude, it is not exact or detailed, but it can still be useful.
cards.e: She drew crude hearts on the ground to show how much she loved him.
cards.ielts: Early humans used crude stone tools, yet these simple inventions were the starting point of all modern technology.

cards.d: A cube is a solid object with six square surfaces that are all the same size.
cards.e: Please get me some ice cubes to put in my soda.
cards.ielts: Housing estates made up of identical concrete cubes may be cheap to build, but they often make neighbourhoods look dull.

cards.d: Feedback is comments to a person about how they are doing something.
cards.e: I asked my boss for feedback on my work.
cards.ielts: Regular feedback from teachers helps students identify their weaknesses and improve more quickly.

cards.d: Ignorance of something is lack of knowledge about it.
cards.e: When he failed the test, his ignorance of math was obvious.
cards.ielts: Public ignorance about healthy diets is one reason why obesity rates have risen so sharply.

cards.d: When something is masculine, it is a quality or thing related to men.
cards.e: American football is usually considered a masculine sport.
cards.ielts: Traditionally, engineering was viewed as a masculine profession, but more women are now entering the field.

cards.d: A monument is a structure that is built to remind people of a person or event.
cards.e: A large monument was built to honor the brave soldiers.
cards.ielts: Historic monuments should be protected by the state, even if maintaining them is expensive.

cards.d: When someone is muscular, they are very fit and strong.
cards.e: He exercised regularly so that his body could become muscular.
cards.ielts: Advertisements showing muscular male models may give teenage boys unrealistic expectations about their bodies.

cards.d: A person’s posture is the position in which they stand or sit.
cards.e: Your back will feel better if you improve your posture.
cards.ielts: Sitting at a desk for hours can lead to poor posture and long-term back pain among office workers.

cards.d: To situate something means to place or build it in a certain place.
cards.e: The road was situated between the forest and the lake.
cards.ielts: New hospitals should be situated near major roads so that ambulances can reach them quickly.

cards.d: To supervise something means to make sure that it is done correctly.
cards.e: Allen supervised the construction workers to ensure everyone’s safety.
cards.ielts: Parents should supervise young children's internet use to protect them from harmful content.

cards.d: Symmetry is the state of having two halves that are exactly the same.
cards.e: The artist made sure to use perfect symmetry when painting the butterfly.
cards.ielts: The perfect symmetry of the three madrasahs on the Registan is one reason it is considered an architectural masterpiece.

cards.d: A tattoo is a design that is drawn permanently on the skin with needles.
cards.e: The surfer had tattoos on both his arms.
cards.ielts: Attitudes towards tattoos have changed so much that many employers no longer object to them in the workplace.

cards.d: An undergraduate is a student at a college who is studying for a bachelor’s degree.
cards.e: She was excited to finish high school and enroll as an undergraduate in the fall.
cards.ielts: The number of undergraduates studying computer science has almost tripled over the past decade.
